description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Wanted: Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At HBX Group , we are a global TravelTech ecosystem connecting and empowering businesses across the world of travel. Through data, innovation, and strong partnerships, we deliver seamless experiences and help our partners grow.

Within our Activities division, we focus on building competitive, high-quality product portfolios that meet evolving market demands. Our teams operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where ownership, adaptability, and collaboration are key to success.

Job Summary

As a Contract Manager , you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a portfolio of suppliers, ensuring the product remains competitive, available, and aligned with market needs.

This role combines supplier relationship management, negotiation, reporting, and operational execution , with a strong focus on performance tracking, prioritization, and continuous improvement . You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive revenue, maintain product quality, and unlock growth opportunities.

Job Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of Activities suppliers, ensuring product availability and competitiveness at all times.
  • Maintain and develop strong relationships with suppliers, acting as the main point of contact.
  • Ensure existing products remain optimized and aligned with market expectations.

Contracting & Negotiation

  • Negotiate commercial conditions including rates, inventory, offers, and contract terms.
  • Ensure renewal contracts are competitive and available in time to capture demand.
  • Benchmark competitors and proactively renegotiate where needed to maintain market positioning.

Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze portfolio performance through bi-weekly reports and statistics , identifying trends and opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and take actions to improve conversion, revenue, and product performance.
  • Provide insights and explanations on portfolio performance using data and market knowledge.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple processes simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively based on business impact and deadlines.
  • Maintain updated product content (rates, inclusions, descriptions, availability).
  • Solve operational issues and coordinate solutions with internal teams and suppliers.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Revenue, Product teams).
  • Support cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment on commercial priorities.
  • Represent HBX Group in supplier meetings and market visits.

Required Skills

  • Strong prioritization and time management , with the ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously.
  • High level of analytical thinking , comfortable working with reports, data, and performance metrics.
  • Strong commercial mindset with negotiation capabilities.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills .
  • High attention to detail and process discipline, with flexibility to manage changing priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently.

Required Tech Skills

  • Experience working with internal systems, contracting tools, or booking platforms .
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles.
  • Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams.
  • Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management.

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Wanted: Power Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Wanted: Power Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our client is seeking a Transmission Line Engineer to join their growing engineering team. This role will be responsible for supporting the analysis, design, and execution of overhead transmission line projects for utility and energy clients.

The ideal candidate will have experience in transmission line design, power systems, and engineering project delivery, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the successful delivery of critical power infrastructure projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform and coordinate transmission line engineering activities for new and existing overhead transmission projects.
  • Complete engineering analysis, calculations, and design work associated with transmission line systems.
  • Provide technical support to internal stakeholders, customers, and project teams.
  • Review project requirements and specifications and recommend design improvements when necessary.
  • Solve complex engineering challenges related to transmission line design and construction.
  • Prepare technical reports, analyses, calculations, and presentations.
  • Perform and oversee transmission line calculations, including:
  • Sag-tension analysis
  • Wire blowout calculations
  • Damper recommendations
  • Conductor and wire selection
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously while meeting project schedules and deadlines.
  • Collaborate with engineering, sales, and project management teams to ensure successful project execution.
  • Travel occasionally to customer sites to support project meetings, technical presentations, and project development activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with an emphasis in Power Systems.
  • Experience working on utility, transmission, or power infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with transmission line design software such as:
  • PLS-CADD
  • SAG10
  • ETAP
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team environment.

What We're Looking For

  • Self-motivated and results-driven professional.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality and accuracy.
  • Customer-focused mindset with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Continuous learner with a passion for professional growth and development.
  • Team player who thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

If you are passionate about power systems, transmission engineering, and delivering innovative solutions for critical infrastructure projects, we would love to hear from you.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Técnico Trabalhista - Contencioso Estratégico em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição

  • Analisar criticamente ações judiciais de alta complexidade com vistas à definição de estratégia técnica.
  • Elaborar, revisar e validar peças processuais complexas (contestação, recursos ordinários e de revista, agravos, memoriais, entre outros).
  • Formular pareceres técnicos sobre temas trabalhistas controversos e de impacto empresarial.
  • Mapear e monitorar tendências jurisprudenciais dos TRTs, TST e STF, com foco em precedentes vinculantes e relevantes.
  • Redigir análises jurídicas voltadas à assessoria estratégica de clientes empresariais.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente sustentações orais, reuniões com clientes estratégicos e apresentações em reuniões jurídicas internas.
  • Promover o controle técnico de qualidade dos conteúdos produzidos, assegurando uniformidade argumentativa e rigor doutrinário/jurisprudencial.
  • Realizar auditorias processuais técnicas e revisão de teses de contestações e recursos.
  • Graduação em Direito com registro ativo na OAB.
  • Pós-graduação em Direito do Trabalho, Processo do Trabalho ou Direito Constitucional do Trabalho.
  • Desejável mestrado ou doutorado em Direito das Relações Sociais ou Direito do Trabalho.
  • Domínio completo da CLT, Constituição Federal (arts. 5º, 7º, 8º e 114 a 117), CPC/2015 (aplicação subsidiária), jurisprudência consolidada do TST e STF.
  • Habilidade na construção de teses estratégicas e argumentações técnico-jurídicas com elevado grau de complexidade.
  • Capacidade de atuação com controle de prazos, acompanhamento técnico e validação processual em alto volume com precisão.

Competências comportamentais

  • Excelência técnica e compromisso com a precisão jurídica.
  • Visão sistêmica e habilidade analítica profunda.
  • Alta capacidade de concentração, foco em resultados e perfil autodirigido.
  • Clareza na comunicação técnica, oral e escrita.
  • Ética profissional e postura compatível com ambientes de alta exigência técnica.
  • Publicações técnicas ou produção acadêmica na área.
  • Participação em comissões temáticas da OAB ou grupos de pesquisa.
  • Vivência com clientes de grande porte, multinacionais ou setores regulados.
  • Certificações ou cursos de curta duração em jurisprudência aplicada, analytics jurídico ou legal design.
  • Conhecimento em Legal Operations e aplicação de BI na análise processual.

Buscamos profissional com sólida formação jurídica e expertise técnica aprofundada para atuar como Head Técnico Trabalhista.

Esta função é voltada à análise, elaboração e revisão de peças de alta complexidade, à estruturação de teses jurídicas estratégicas, ao acompanhamento de jurisprudência relevante e à sustentação técnica de teses perante tribunais.

Espera-se domínio técnico excepcional, atuação orientada à mitigação de riscos e elevada capacidade de raciocínio jurídico verticalizado.

Você atua do branding à peça de campanha , do online ao offline , da identidade à animação, sempre conectando estética a resultado. Crescimento de verdade, autonomia pra criar, testar e errar, e projetos que deixam marca no mundo real.

Iniciativa, transparência, respeito, responsabilidade e vontade genuína de evoluir.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 126 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 28 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 14.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Gurilândia e Land Scholl são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos, que superam desafios diariamente com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará

  • Executar pequenos reparos em estruturas, instalações elétricas, hidráulicas e sanitárias;
  • Realizar serviços de pintura, alvenaria e manutenção de mobiliários;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar serviços de empresas terceirizadas (segurança, limpeza técnica, dedetização, etc.);
  • Realizar vistorias periódicas nas instalações para identificar e prevenir possíveis problemas;
  • Apoiar na montagem e desmontagem de equipamentos e mobiliário em eventos escolares;
  • Cuidar da limpeza e organização de áreas técnicas (salas de manutenção, almoxarifado, etc.);
  • Zelar pela segurança dos alunos e colaboradores durante atividades de manutenção;
  • Seguir normas de segurança do trabalho e utilizar os EPIs adequados.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em elétrica, hidráulica, pintura e alvenaria;
  • Noções de segurança do trabalho;
  • Proatividade, responsabilidade e organização;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente escolar.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Cursos de NR 10 (Segurança em Instalações Elétricas);
  • Cursos profissionalizantes na área de manutenção predial, elétrica, hidráulica, pintura, ou áreas correlatas.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Temos fome de inovação e resultados. Sempre buscando fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e agindo com agilidade e responsabilidade. Valorizamos a diversidade, o conhecimento e o compartilhamento em um ambiente dinâmico e versátil.

O ingrediente especial da nossa receita? As pessoas. Vem fazer parte disso!

We are looking for an experienced Functional Business Consultant (with Infor WMS experience) to support us with WMS Integration and Implementation projects, Audits and Consulting projects.

Innovecs is a global digital transformation tech company with a presence in the US, the UK, the EU, Israel, Australia, and Ukraine. Specializing in software solutions, the Innovecs team has experience in Supply Chain, Healthtech, Software & Hightech, and Gaming.

  • Experience performing WMS system configuration and minor functional enhancements;
  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills;

  • Understanding of 3PL operational processes and customer implementations is a strong plus;

  • Troubleshoot functional issues, investigate root causes, and coordinate resolution with technical teams when required;

  • Monitor support tickets, prioritise customer issues, and ensure timely resolution;

  • Recommend process improvements and optimisation opportunities within warehouse operations and WMS configuration;
  • Maintain strong understanding of Infor WMS best practices and emerging Supply Chain technology trends;
  • Act as a subject matter expert for Infor WMS configuration and warehouse operational workflows.

  • Orientação a Resultados e Negócio: Conectar a estratégia do produto diretamente aos KPIs críticos do negócio, garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e retorno sobre o investimento.

  • Liderar e influenciar stakeholders transversais de forma clara, estruturada e colaborativa, garantindo o alinhamento de prioridades complexas.

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, e-commerce, ecossistemas complexos ou produtos digitais de alta escala;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de negócio, com histórico comprovado de tomada de decisão baseada em dados e métricas financeiras/operacionais;
  • Vivência prática em processos de discovery profundos com stakeholders de diferentes perfis (técnicos e não-técnicos);

Alta taxa de adoção e engajamento das soluções lançadas pelas áreas usuárias; Impacto mensurável nos principais KPIs de negócio atrelados ao produto; Capacidade de entrega consistente e redução do lead time entre a descoberta da dor e o valor entregue; Sólido alinhamento e alto índice de confiança estabelecido com os principais stakeholders.

  • Build and maintain end-to-end automation frameworks;
  • Execute functional, regression, and integration testing;

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives;
  • Stay current with the React Native testing ecosystem and contribute to migration to the React Native New Architecture.

  • 4+ years of professional mobile QA experience ;

  • Experience with BrowserStack or Sauce Labs ;
  • Knowledge of Firebase and Sentry ;
  • Basic understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript and React Native architecture ;
  • API testing experience ;
  • Experience validating mobile payment flows ;
  • Clear communication and collaboration skills;
  • Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with payment integrations such as Adyen, Apple Pay, and Google Pay;
  • Familiarity with feature flag systems such as LaunchDarkly;
  • Exposure to mobile analytics platforms such as Adobe Experience Platform and Quantum Metric;
  • ADA accessibility testing and WCAG standards knowledge;
  • Performance testing including render budgets and memory profiling on mobile;
  • Internationalization (i18n) and multi-language app testing;
  • Experience with App Store and Google Play submission and validation processes.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth : Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation : USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.

With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Sales Account Executive (Closer)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sales Account Executive (Closer) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We work alongside ambitious SaaS teams as long-term design partners, helping translate complex challenges into meaningful user experiences that support real business growth.

Our approach is embedded, focused on partnership and outcomes, rather than transactions. While UX/UI is at our core, we support everything design-related — from product and web to motion, graphic design, and branding.

About the Role

We’re looking for a high-ownership, consultative Account Executive to drive new business for Foundey. This is an end-to-end sales role where you’ll own the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting through discovery, strategic alignment, proposal development, and close. You’ll work directly with founders, product leaders, and engineering executives at fast-growing SaaS and AI companies.

Success in this role requires strong discovery skills, the ability to diagnose product and growth challenges, and comfort selling high-value design engagements. This is not a transactional sales motion. It requires both commercial sharpness and genuine empathy — someone who listens deeply, understands a founder’s context and constraints, and builds trust through thoughtful, consultative conversations, not just pressure-driven tactics.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and close B2B SaaS deals end-to-end, working with cutting edge startups to Series A/B organizations
  • Generate outbound pipeline and build opportunities from scratch
  • Sell SaaS, technology solutions, or tech-enabled services (especially UX/UI, but also graphic, web and motion design services)
  • Lead strategic discovery calls with senior decision-makers
  • Run compelling discovery calls and live working sessions, along with delivering executive-level presentations
  • Multi-thread deals across stakeholders
  • Drive negotiations with confidence
  • Maintain disciplined forecasting and deal control
  • Consistently exceed aggressive revenue quotas

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 3+ years of B2B sales experience
  • Strong experience closing enterprise SaaS and/or Technology Solutions Bonus: UX/UI service deals
  • Proven, documented track record of exceeding quota
  • Experience selling to startups and scale-ups, especially within North America
  • Deep understanding of selling technology to product-driven companies
  • Native or fluent English (mandatory)
  • Exceptional closing, negotiation, and objection-handling skills
  • Executive presence and strong communication
  • Highly competitive, resilient, and performance-driven
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and early-stage environments
  • High ownership mindset with a drive to create impact

Must-haves

  • You have demonstrated closing opportunities from end-to-end
  • Take full ownership of achieving your quarterly quota / goals
  • You thrive in a high pace environment
  • Demonstrated the ability to close multi-threaded deals
  • Ability to work with multiple Buyer Personas - Founders, CEOs, CIO/CTO, VP of Engineering
  • Nice to Have - worked in a startup environment

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

Head Of Compliance (Brazil Resident)

Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company''s track record with the BCB from zero.

What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company''s best interest

What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else''s
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires

Nice-to-have

  • Prior compliance experience specifically within a crypto exchange or VASP
